diagnosis: Job astrbot-diff-62395e1970221c48d96cf48446c85a6abcce946cb757e27da92db62c0f9fc20b (ab-f95a046886ecbe3efcf97251 / mcupdate_latest): astrbot_plugin_mc_update builds replies from surrogate escapes such as \ud83d\udcf0 in str literals. The Native side's json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) protocol line raised UnicodeEncodeError (surrogates not allowed), so both passed Native Workers emitted status=failed and lost every reply. The Federated side completed but all 8 calls were silent (no reply delivered): a product finding, not a harness defect.
fix: Native side normalizes text as a UTF-16 consumer would (pairs joined, lone surrogates to U+FFFD); encodable text is byte-identical. Commit ac7bbfe on branch codex/p709-native-surrogates, intentionally not applied to this run because the plan pins harness source hashes.
decision: User decision 2026-11-15: resume this run unchanged; the gate tolerates this signature up to 1% per batch and lists patch_candidates; after the campaign, only those jobs are rerun under a corrected plan.
batch_rerun: Deferred to the corrected-plan patch run; the terminal row (unknown) is not rewritten.
